verdict.rationale: Shopify's own shipping page documents label creation at scale (up to 250 labels at once) and a single view of orders from all sales channels, so the label-buying part of the story is delivered in-platform. Nothing in the pack shows live carrier rates at checkout or shipment tracking for the merchant. missing for 10: evidence of live carrier rates shown at checkout, in-platform shipment tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration of label purchasing.

support.subject: As an operations lead, checkout shows live carrier rates and I can buy labels and track shipments from the platform

citations.quote: Create up to 250 labels at once to process at scale
Orders from all your sales channels in one place
